facts.title: Vegan Banana Nut Scones
ingredients: 2 cups white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour
⅓ cup solid coconut oil or 5 tablespoons cold butter
¾ cup mashed ripe banana (about 2 medium bananas)
¼ cup milk of choice (almond milk, etc.)
1 tablespoon melted coconut oil or butter
¼ cup maple syrup, add more if needed
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
